question: Can nix builds run under `hermit run --strict` WITHOUT a host nix-install and WITHOUT host-root, by running hermit inside a nixos/nix OCI image in rootless podman? Does ptrace work in the rootless-podman userns?
option_evaluated: Option 1 — hermit-inside-rootless-podman (near-term unblock for rb-nix track)

host.no_host_nix_used: container builds use ONLY the image's nix; the host /nix present is a leftover from the prior rb-nix task and was NOT mounted into the winning build (TEST H/recipe run --rm, no /nix bind)

recipe.why_hostlibs_loader: nixos/nix image has no /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2; run hermit via explicit host loader + host libs from ldd(hermit)
recipe.why_seccomp_unconfined: default podman seccomp ENOSYS's personality(2); reverie needs it to disable ASLR
recipe.why_no_namespace: full-namespace hermit needs mount/UTS caps rootless podman can't grant (Hostname/Mount EPERM); podman already provides the container
recipe.why_old_nix: modern nix (2.35) signals the builder via pidfd_send_signal (nr 424); detcore classifies it Unsupported (fails closed under --strict); nix 2.3.16 uses plain kill()

results.ptrace_in_rootless_userns: PASS (hermit run --strict --no-namespace traces guest, virtualized pids) — the core task question, answered YES
results.nix_build_under_strict_old_nix: PASS (nixos/nix:2.3.16): /nix/store/...-hermit-strict-hello built, rc=0, NO host nix, NO host-root
results.nix_build_modern_nix_2_35: FAIL under --strict AND non-strict: pidfd_send_signal blocks builder management ('killing process N: Function not implemented', hangs)

detcore_refs: hermit/detcore/src/lib.rs:284-309 (handle_unsupported_syscall: --strict fails closed; else host passthrough)
root_cause_modern_nix.minimal_probe: recipe/pidfd_probe.c: native-in-container OK; under hermit pidfd_open=fd3 OK but pidfd_send_signal -> detcore ERROR + sandbox abort

recommendations: Implement pidfd_send_signal (and pidfd_getfd) in detcore: translate the FdType::Pidfd target to the virtual pid and deliver the signal deterministically. Unblocks modern nix (2.35) under --strict.
Until then, the container recipe works today with pre-pidfd nix (2.3.16) under --strict.
Option 2 (hermit-as-container-runtime via containers/storage) remains the cleaner long-term seam; Option 1 is validated as the immediate unblock.
